title: Wholemeal Penne with Avocado Alfredo
subtitle: with golden pumpkin balls
description: Wholemeal penne coated in a creamy avocado sauce and served with pan-fried pumpkin balls and shaved parmesan.

steps.text: Boil a large pot of lightly salted water. Cook the penne uncovered over medium heat for 12 to 13 minutes (wholemeal pasta takes longer).
While the pasta cooks, scoop the pumpkin into small balls with a melon baller. Fry the balls in a pan with the olive oil until golden.
Blend the peeled avocados to a smooth cream and season with salt, pepper and lemon juice.
Drain the pasta, then toss with the avocado sauce and pumpkin balls.
Transfer to plates, top with shaved parmesan and serve hot.
